description: Häfen der Donau - Österreich is a dataset listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by haleconnect.com. Ports of the Danube in Austria km 1872.7 to km 2201.5. Coverage: AT. The portal shows the English title as "Ports of the Danube — Austria" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Häfen, HighValueDataset, Donau. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-austria.
